summary: Master advanced inventory optimisation. Learn safety stock modeling, demand forecasting, and MEIO to reduce costs and improve service levels. Enroll today.
lede: Inventory optimisation helps experienced supply chain, procurement, warehouse and finance professionals balance stock availability with the cost of holding inventory. The course develops skills in demand segmentation and forecasting, safety stock and replenishment planning, and inventory visibility and KPI reporting. Participants apply these methods to address stock imbalances and make evidence-based inventory decisions.
audienceIntro: This advanced programme is tailored for experienced professionals responsible for the financial and operational performance of inventory assets across the supply chain.
modules: Strategic Inventory Foundations and SCOR Alignment
Safety Stock Modeling and Variability Management
Warehouse Operations and Digital Inventory Visibility
Supplier Integration and Collaborative Inventory Models
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 5 years of experience in supply chain, logistics, or procurement. A working knowledge of basic statistical concepts (mean, standard deviation) and proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis are required. No prior coding knowledge is necessary, though familiarity with ERP environments is beneficial.
